justification: The only real correspondence is the universal motif of upright human figures with arms raised, shown at differing sizes side by side, and some elongated linear elements crossing above them. Everything specific differs: A shows an offering scene beneath a rayed disc above dense rows of script, with modelled, proportioned bodies in profile, while B shows crudely schematic solid-silhouette figures with stick limbs, no disc, no script, and no framing register.
